name: worth
description: Worth — Free Money Calculators: 419 SEO pages (86 calculators/guides + 46 article cluster + 286-page 13-language wage conversion cluster), PWA, open source MIT, GitHub Pages DA 99. This repo also hosts HOOKED (hooked/), Affiliate Income Lab (affiliate-marketing/) and Forge Workspace (workspace-service/).

scripts.build:verify: SITE_URL=https://njohn931d-dotcom.github.io/bbbh npm run build:production && npm run verify:dist
scripts.verify:dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const checks=[['dist/index.html','home'],['dist/404.html','404 fallback'],['dist/.nojekyll','.nojekyll'],['dist/manifest.json','PWA manifest'],['dist/sitemap.xml','sitemap'],['dist/robots.txt','robots'],['dist/feed.xml','RSS'],['dist/llms.txt','LLM index']]; let ok=true; for(const [f,l] of checks){ if(fs.existsSync(f)){ console.log('✓ '+l+': '+f+' ('+fs.statSync(f).size+' bytes)'); } else { console.error('✗ missing '+l+': '+f); ok=false; } } const htmlCount=require('child_process').execSync('find dist -name index.html | wc -l',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim(); console.log('✓ HTML pages: '+htmlCount); const sitemapUrls=(fs.readFileSync('dist/sitemap.xml','utf8').match(/<loc>/g)||[]).length; console.log('✓ Sitemap URLs: '+sitemapUrls); if(!ok) process.exit(1);"
scripts.publish:all: npm run deploy:check && echo 'Ready to push to main for GitHub Pages deploy'
